answer: Farming becomes a garden bet on surviving 117 epochs of grading, and every fable settlement recomputes the grove schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 117 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
